name: Edogawa Conan
source:
First Grade Student at Teitan Elementary. His true identity is that of high school detective Shinichi Kudou. His body was shrunk after being poisoned by the Black Organization, but that did not stop him from solving numerous cases.

Taken from the game's character profile.
